name: Clan Fall
summary: CLAN FALL is an online strategy board game for 2 to 4 players, played in a web browser. Players build roads, houses and villages on a hex map, trade resources and race for points, either as individuals or in teams of two. In team games, one card lets a player secretly ask an opponent to switch sides, and another tells a team whether a Fault is among them. Players can form clans that compete in weekly city wars.
